domainModel.lib/production/qc.ts: Pure functions + schemas. Thresholds frozen from QUALITY_GATES.md:19,35-37: integrated loudness -14 LUFS ±1.0 (pass [-15.0,-13.0]); true peak <= -1.0 dBTP; expected duration within 1 frame at 24fps; audio end within 1 frame; black >= 6 frames outside approved fades; freeze >= 48 frames; unexplained silence >= 24000 samples inside a spoken cue — last three ADVISORIES (evidence to inspect, never autonomous acceptance) each carrying detector version + exact interval. Automated blockers (no waiver): decoder failure, wrong codec/container/dimensions/fps/pix_fmt, missing required audio stream when manifest has audio cues, nonfinite probe values, checksum failure, duration beyond 1-frame tolerance, hard clipping/truepeak violation, required spoken segment omitted from declared cues. Silent-draft profile (audioMixRevisionId null / audioCues empty): video/checksum/duration checks apply, audio-stream/loudness checks SKIPPED, report draftOnly:true, and draftOnly can NEVER become release-ready. Exports: parseEbur128Summary(ffmpeg ebur128 stderr), parseBlackFreezeSilence(blackdetect/freezedetect/silencedetect), evaluateQc -> {verdict passed|failed, blockers[], advisories[]}, buildQcReport -> schema {id 'qc-'+sha256, exportId, manifestId, manifestInputsHash, outputAssetId, outputSha256, measured{integratedLufs, truePeakDbtp, durationFrames, codec/container/dimensions/fps}, checklist expected/actual/evidence, advisory[], toolVersions{ffmpeg,ffprobe}, detectorThresholds, verdict, draftOnly, createdAt}. Deterministic given identical measurements.

(c) Route handler factories with withStore/dataDir injection seams: createExportItemRouteHandlers (GET {export, manifestSummary{profile, shotCount, audioCueCount, inputsHash}, qcReport|null, failure|null, owningProjectId}; POST same-origin {kind:'run_qc'} | {kind:'final_review', ...}); createExportDownloadRouteHandlers; createExportDraftRouteHandlers.

downloadSemantics.finalRoute: GET /api/production/exports/[id]/download?projectId=<owning>: validate id; export -> manifest -> owning project; projectId missing/mismatch -> INVALID_INPUT; unknown -> 404; status !== 'approved' -> 428 naming the blocking state + human G09 requirement (technical QC alone never unlocks); approvedSha256 !== current asset.sha256 -> 409 STALE_REVISION; else 200 body from vault.readVerified, headers content-type asset.mime, content-length, content-disposition attachment 'export-<first 12 sha>.mp4', etag '"<sha256>"', cache-control no-store, x-perabyte-final: 1. NO Range v1. No vaultRef/paths in any header/body.
downloadSemantics.draftRoute: GET /api/production/exports/[id]/draft?projectId=...: allowed qc_pending|qc_failed|ready_for_review; 'approved' -> 409 pointing at final route; 'failed'/'canceled' (assetId null) -> 409 embedding failure.json code/stage/redactedStderr; bytes via readVerified with DRAFT-/QC-FAILED- disposition prefix + x-perabyte-draft: 1. A Draft/QC-failed artifact NEVER receives Ready-to-upload/final/release badge (UI AND route enforced).
downloadSemantics.retryRule: Retry = POST exports with NEW idempotencyKey (new export id); prior exports remain listed; nothing deleted.
